lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Algeria. The dataset represents approximately 4.0 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 4 years, supplemented by AI-based mapping estimates to assess coverage completeness. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for disaster risk exposure assessment.
